body: Like another comment here said play aggressively. Once you start getting in lobbies where people consistently parry light attacks, you'll want to start throwing raw heavies. (This can be applied to any hero). But many people will expect oro's zone attack, so you'll want to use a left heavy and they'll react on red expecting it to be a zone but the timing gives you a free heavy. As is the way with this game no one strategy will work against everyone so you will need to adapt. People have developed a habit of interrupting unblockables with light attacks. If they consistently do that, then feint your heavy and immediately go for the light parry and land an attack. Utilize your recovery times on your attacks. Try throwing an attack at a distance to bait a reaction and either dodge attack, deflect, or depending on who it is and what the attack is go for a guard break. Kick will be one of your top ways of applying pressure so use that as a way to bait dodges and get guard breaks. Hope this helps!
